Zelenskyy Warns Countries as Russia Uses Foreign Recruits in Ukraine

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has issued a warning to 47 countries, stating that Russia is employing foreign recruits in the ongoing war. Meanwhile, Russia has reportedly targeted Ukraine's data centers.
